sloka: ततः भूत उपसृष्टा इव वेपमाना पुनः पुनः ।धरण्याम् गत सत्त्वा इव कौसल्या सूतम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-६०-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ bhūta upasṛṣṭā iva vepamānā punaḥ punaḥ ।dharaṇyām gata sattvā iva kausalyā sūtam abravīt ॥2-60-1॥

translations.english: Thereafter Kausalya, trembling as if possessed by an evil spirit and rolling on the floor like one who her senses now and again, said to the charioteer (Sumantra):
